integrity: The result is proved analytically from monotonicity of fixed-radius path averages and an endpoint mean estimate.
The finite exact-rational verifier is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only nonnegative monotone functions on finite paths and only 1-variation; the full path-graph conjecture for arbitrary data remains open.
The argument does not address functions with changes of monotonic direction or p-variation with p different from 1.
Targeted database and web searches cannot exclude an unindexed folklore observation in different terminology.
title: Monotone data attain the conjectured path-graph variational constant
